name: Mina
bonusDescription: Monitors security patrols, warns you when rivals move on your walls, and makes rivals back off more often.
hint: Hangs out near the corner store.
missionDescription: Recover her blackbook from the north alley.

dialogue.meet: I'm Moth. Ghost Line lifted my blackbook — years of outlines in there. They stashed it in the north alley. Get it back and I'll be your lookout.
dialogue.active: The blackbook's still in the north alley, behind Ghost Line's tags. Watch yourself in there.
dialogue.recovered: You actually got it back. Okay — you paint, I watch. I'm in your crew.
dialogue.recruited: Eyes open. I'll whistle if security loops close or anyone creeps on your walls.

name: Rico
bonusDescription: Assists murals and auto-fills throw-ups on open walls in claimed territory.
hint: Sketching fat letters by the loading dock.
missionDescription: Recover his cap case from the train siding.

dialogue.meet: Call me Caps. City's sitting on my cap case by the train siding. Get that back and I'll fatten your fills wherever you hold ground.
dialogue.active: My caps are still out by the siding. Chrome boys won't use 'em right anyway.
dialogue.recovered: That's the case. Say less — your walls need weight, and I got the hand for it.
dialogue.recruited: Point me at a held block and I'll make the empty spots look claimed.

name: Jay
bonusDescription: Calls one free escape per heat level before security can dock your rep or paint.
hint: Leans on the footbridge, listening for patrol radios.
missionDescription: Recover his transit scanner from the south alley.

dialogue.meet: Metro. I run shortcuts by sound. My scanner's in the south alley — bring it back and I'll pull you out when heat turns ugly.
dialogue.active: Scanner's still south alley. Without it, I'm guessing at sirens like everybody else.
dialogue.recovered: That's my scanner. Now when heat jumps, I can hear the gap before security closes it.
dialogue.recruited: Keep moving. I got one clean route per heat level before they learn it.
